state.lastRunNotes: No fresh dated catalysts: AAPL's iPhone Duo pre-order 'get ready' step starts Oct 12 (orders Oct 16) which is already priced into the existing thesis, GOOGL's DOJ cross-appeal is still mid-briefing with no ruling, and META's Muse coverage is all from September with nothing new today. Today's broad tech weakness (INTC -5.95%, ORCL -5.2%, AVGO -4.12%, AMD -4.23%, NVDA -3.02%) came on below-average volume with no dated news explaining it, and most of those names are DOWN-trend or lack a real catalyst, so no new buys. Holding across the board; growth/core split stays at roughly 60/40 (GOOGL+META growth vs AAPL core), within the 35-65% band. All three held positions already carry plans, so none needed updating.

rescaled.note: Scaled from a separate portfolio into an A$10,000 slice of one A$40,000 fund on 2026-09-25.

trades.horizon: Medium-term (~2-4 months) — through the iPhone Duo launch cycle and holiday-quarter earnings
trades.rationale: Apple unveiled the $1,999 foldable iPhone Duo, its biggest hardware redesign in years; Citi reiterated Buy with a $365 target and called it Apple's most significant new hardware category since the Watch/AirPods.
trades.sentimentSummary: Analyst commentary strongly bullish on the Duo launch; stock rallying even as broader tech sells off.

trades.horizon: Medium-term (~1-3 months) — tracking Muse AI adoption/monetization signals into next earnings
trades.rationale: Meta's Muse AI agent (task-completing assistant, #3 in App Store) is driving a fresh bull case beyond ads; JPMorgan upgraded to Buy ($820 PT) and Goldman reaffirmed Buy after the launch.
trades.sentimentSummary: Wall Street broadly bullish post-Muse launch, with some debate over monetization risk longer term.

trades.horizon: Short-to-medium-term (4-8 weeks) — reassess into Alphabet's Oct 27, 2026 Q3 earnings as the post-ruling rally digests and DOJ appeal risk is monitored.
trades.rationale: A federal judge's antitrust remedy ruling lets Google keep Chrome and avoids a forced breakup, removing a years-long regulatory overhang; shares are up sharply post-ruling with a Strong Buy analyst consensus (~$428 avg PT, 58 buys/0 sells) and bullish chatter calling it a breakout to fresh highs.
trades.sentimentSummary: Broadly bullish across financial media and retail trader chatter (TradingView/Reddit-adjacent) framing the ruling as a major overhang removed; Jim Cramer called it a 'shockingly favorable' outcome.

trades.horizon: Intraday — close by end of trading day; will be closed this session or forcibly flattened at the 3:50pm ET close-out slot per the day-trade rule.
trades.rationale: AMD is leading a broad semiconductor sector rally today (NVDA, INTC also up) on continued AI-buildout enthusiasm and carried-over bullish analyst conviction from the prior session; Strong Buy consensus (44 buys/0 sells). Playing sector momentum into the close as a short intraday swing, not a multi-week fundamental thesis.
trades.sentimentSummary: Wall Street strongly bullish (Strong Buy consensus, no sell ratings); WallStreetBets sentiment mixed (45% positive/55% negative over past 24h) despite the price momentum, a caution flag against chasing the move too hard.

trades.rationale: Mandatory flatten before market close per the day-trade rule — no overnight day-trade holds, ever. The semiconductor-rally momentum stalled into the close, leaving the position essentially flat.
trades.sentimentSummary: Sector rally lost steam in the final hour; no fresh catalyst to justify holding overnight even if permitted.
